notes.title: Patch 1.0.12 Released - Leaderboards Reset!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RuHNzn8.gif[/img]

Hey everyone!

First of all we want to thank all of you for doing your share of demon killing and earning some incredible high scores ːtxphornsː. Below are the winners of our first Season:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27762614/fdfffeedb7a5cec9dbc4526e723bb3acb66f0b19.png[/img]

With this new patch you'll have a fresh shot at hitting the top 13. But be ready, the rules have changed. Be ready for an even harder game!


[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[code]
- Custom controls saved
- Leaderboards can be scrolled
- 6:66 Challenge winners added into demon name pool
- Bollocks don't like farming
- All bosses can now attack you from offscreen
- Carrion no longer gets stuck in walls
- Windowed mode toggle in options
- Vibration slider in options
- Shielder hitbox adjusted
- Effects adjusted for shielder charge, sparks, electricity
- Difficulty continues to increase when bosses are active
- Gutshank's Gutbots changed for clarity
- Priest bullets changed for clarity
- Wallie Upgrade bullets changed for clarity
- Shielders in Hard Mode can't charge right after spawning
[/code]

[b]Welcome back to Planet Fuck You![/b] ːtxpdemonː

notes.title: Tormentor❌Punisher Out Now!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/iP9rUOL.gif[/img]

[h1]Welcome to Planet Fuck You![/h1]

[i](this is probably a good time for a warning about profane language, right?
Here's one: WARNING!)[/i]

Everything in Tormentor❌Punisher can be killed in one hit, including bosses and yourself. Bosses change the shape of the arena, conjuring rooms and traps to make it more hellish and brutal. 

Explore and discover new ways of killing enemies to gain cool upgrades that have great names like "Hot Stuff" and "Fuck You," and other terms just bursting with friendliness. Reload your machine gun by firing your shotgun. Yeah, you read that right.

All of this is in the name of leaderboards and bragging to strangers on the internet about how much better you are than them at video games. There is local co-op in the game, too! Grab a controller and a friend to wreck demon ass. 

[i]PAX East Booth 2017:[/i]
[img]http://i.imgur.com/HFMcX37.gif[/img]


[h1]Want to learn more about the game? Here are some great videos to get you started:[/h1]

[url=https://youtu.be/-mcPKcOdIfk]Launch Trailer:[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/-mcPKcOdIfk][img]http://i.imgur.com/faaLQS7.gif[/img][/url]

[url=https://youtu.be/dRDjgf3DMDE]The Most Metal Tutorial Video Ever:[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/dRDjgf3DMDE][img]http://i.imgur.com/uicJZQf.gif[/img][/url]

We hope you enjoy your time on Planet Fuck You. See you in the leaderboards... Right? ☠
